about_the_game:
Dream Place: A Safe, Chill World to Explore

Step into Dream Place, an indie game that invites you to wander through peaceful and mysterious environments, collect objects, and create your own personal safe place.

Your Journey, Your Pace, Your Story.

Dream Place blends relaxing exploration with hidden secrets waiting to be uncovered. Whether you choose to build a cozy sanctuary in Dream Mode or test your survival skills in Survival Mode, there's something for everyone.

Alone or with friends in multiplayer mode, shape the world of your dreams.

Two Unique Experiences, Depending on Your Mood

🌿 Dream Mode - Relax, Explore, Create

Need a break from stress? Dream Mode is perfect for you.

  • Explore stunning landscapes where the journey matters more than the destination.
  • Collect objects and design your own peaceful retreat.
  • Wander through tranquil zones or venture into darker, more mysterious places hiding untold stories.
  • No goals, no pressure—just pure relaxation.

🔥 Survival Mode - Face the Challenge, Adapt, Overcome

Looking for a more intense experience? Survival Mode adds an extra layer of challenge to your journey.

  • Manage your health, hunger, and energy to survive.
  • Gather resources and tackle the trials of a world as beautiful as it is dangerous.
  • Make crucial decisions and adapt to your surroundings.
  • The same immersive world, but with a thrilling survival twist!

Are you ready to step into your dream sanctuary?
